standard_prerequisites.name: Restricted Yoneda, Day convolution and pure-injective representation of injectives for a rigidly-compactly generated category
standard_prerequisites.reference: Krause2000 Cor2.4; BKS2019§2/AppendixA; BKS2020 AppendixA, recalled294–394
standard_prerequisites.use: Foundational module-category facts, including exact internal Hom into injectives, are provided. The local weak-ring/maximal-ideal and residue-pullback arguments are proved, not assumed.

standard_prerequisites.name: Gabriel localization of Grothendieck categories and finitely presented generation
standard_prerequisites.use: This pre-existing tensor-kernel recovery and finite-presentation infrastructure is supplied. The article-specific comparison E_B=E_C, uniqueness of the maximal localizing ideal, maximality of residue pullbacks, the summand construction and both image inclusions remain required proof obligations.
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a Serre tensor ideal B of finitely presented T^c-modules and its pure-injective weak ring E_B, B={M finitely presented: hat(E_B) tensor M=0} and Loc(B)=Ker(hat(E_B) tensor -); the quotient is locally coherent and a subobject of a finitely presented object is the filtered colimit of its finitely presented subobjects. These are the pre-existing BKS2019 results recalled423–443, especially433; they are permitted input, not a new claim of this article.

standard_prerequisites.name: Brown–Neeman representability, adjunctions and projection formula for coproduct-preserving tt functors
standard_prerequisites.use: General adjoint existence and projection formula; lifting residue categories and detecting the image are not supplied.

standard_prerequisites.name: Homological nilpotence theorem for a map from a compact object
standard_prerequisites.reference: Balmer2020a Nilpotence theorems via homological residue fields
standard_prerequisites.use: Used only in the additional weak-ring detection conclusion705 retained with its author proof; image equality uses the preceding support equality, not a new proof of the nilpotence theorem.

core_obligations: Construct the pure-injective weak ring and prove that larger proper localizing tensor ideals share it; derive the unique maximal localizing ideal.
Show that inverse image of a homological prime is maximal and that its residue weak ring is a direct summand of U(E_C).
Establish both inclusions for the image: a unital action handles one direction; finite presentation, a kernel ideal and the projection formula force the converse.

proof_roadmap.step: Use flat weak-ring units and injective hulls through a two-stage Gabriel quotient to identify E_B with E_C and characterize the unique maximal localizing ideal.

spans.label: weak-ring support equality with full author proof

proof_roadmap.step: Translate internal-Hom support into a quotient functor and establish naive-support equality for weak rings.

spans.label: complete residue-functor pullback and pure-injective summand proof

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the functor between residue categories and extract the required pure-injective direct summand.
Use the action of U(1) on U(E_C); conversely prove the tensor kernel of F(E_B) proper by finite presentation and projection formula, then enlarge to a maximal ideal mapping back to B.

difficulty_reason: With the explicit Yoneda/Day, Gabriel-localization, BKS2019 tensor-kernel recovery and adjoint infrastructure allowed, the complete solution still has three research-level structural obligations. It identifies the unique maximal localizing tensor ideal through a pure-injective weak ring; constructs a maximal pulled-back homological prime and lifts the residue injective hull as a direct summand; then forces existence of a prime over a support point using a finitely presented kernel witness and the projection formula. This linked noncompact-support construction and detection argument, rather than the length or publication venue, supports H3. Root adopted the two independent H3 judgments for the unchanged full proof scope; revision-bound review files are required before ready status.
